lines: Both gave 14%. Why call one riskier?

Standard deviation shows the swing. Maximum drawdown shows the worst fall from a peak. Beta above 1 means bigger moves than the benchmark. Sharpe is return above a safe-deposit rate per unit of volatility. All of them look backwards.
